about_the_game:
Detective of the Dead is a narrative adventure game with RPG elements in which you are a dead detective in the colorful Mexican afterworld. 

A very personal matter drives you undercover, you want to find the people who killed you – and as a harmless cook you get close too all sorts of suspects for your cases. And the better you cook for them the more they tell you what you want to know. At night you use these clues to get further in the cases.
It turns out your case is connected to something bigger, so only you can prevent a conspiracy to ruin the famous Día de los Muertos forever, basically the most important day for all the dead and many of the living. No pressure! But yes, that the main quest, if you wondered.

Luckily you are not alone: your magic companion dog Xolo helps you investigate and solve cases with magic abilities. Actually you switch to become Xolo to do all that. Yourself you still need to do some clever interrogation, clue finding, getting puzzles done and winning in mini-games like shooting Piñatas.

Your path will cross with dead gangsters to royals and world known artists. From the street level to the roofs to the interior of houses or bars - you can explore the underworld.

Get into preparing original Mexican food. Knowing the best original Mexican food recipes in the afterworld can help you far...

Things in the afterworld are a bit different than in the world of the living. And it's not just these ancient god's powers...

On the Day of the Dead everyone of the Dead can travel to the world of the living (as you might know from Coco, the film) - if they have Marigold, the nice orange flower. And the more you have, the longer you can stay with the living. That made Marigold to the unofficial currency in the afterworld. So if someone steals all the Marigold from everyone, no one will travel to the living, this would ruin everything. But why would anyone steal so much Marigold? To do what with it? In any case the Dead clearly have a problem. And you are their best chance to solve it.

Depending on your decisions the outcome will change for the better or worse. We hope you can solve the big case and make sure the Dead can go to the world of the Living on the Día de los Muertos.

Thanks for the support of the prototype:

content_descriptors.notes: Its an exciting and comic fun adventure in the land of the dead people in top down view, nothing to be scared about.

name: Detective of the Dead
short_description: You are a dead undercover Detective in the Mexican afterworld. Cook tacos for suspects by day. Investigate them at night. The better you cook the more they tell you. Switch to be your companion dog Xolo & do magic things. Solve many cases to stop evil to ruin the Día de los Muertos forever.
supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, French, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil
